diagnosticIssues.title: No Power / AC Won't Turn On
diagnosticIssues.description: No Power / AC Won't Turn On

diagnosticIssues.title: Weak Airflow or No Air Coming Out
diagnosticIssues.description: Weak Airflow or No Air Coming Out

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is the AC turning on and showing lights on the display?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya AC chal raha hai aur display par lights dikhai de rahi hain?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Which best describes the cooling issue?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Cooling ki samasya ko kaunsa option sabse achha describe karta hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is the AC set to 'Cool' mode (Snowflake symbol) at 18°C with High Fan Speed?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya AC 'Cool' mode (Snowflake icon) par 18°C aur High Fan Speed par set hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is the air filter dusty or clogged with dirt?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya air filter dhool ya kachre se bhara hua hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Did cleaning and drying the filter resolve the cooling issue?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Filter ko dho kar sukhane ke baad kya cooling behtar hui?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is the outdoor unit compressor and fan running smoothly without unusual humming or clicking?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya outdoor unit ka fan aur compressor bina kisi ajeeb awaaz ke chal rahe hain?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is there ice or frost forming on the thin copper pipe or indoor cooling coil?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya patle copper pipe ya indoor cooling coil par barf (ice) jam rahi hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Does the AC display or any indicator LED turn on?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya AC display ya koi bhi LED light ON ho rahi hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Display lights up, but does the AC start blowing air when you press Power on the remote?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Display par light aa rahi hai, par remote se power dabane par kya hawa chalu hoti hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Have you tried pressing the ON/OFF button on the AC unit itself (manual emergency switch under the front panel)?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya aapne indoor unit ke panel ke andar diye gaye manual power button ko dabaya?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is the dedicated MCB (breaker) for the AC switched ON in your home's main distribution board?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya aapke distribution box mein AC ka MCB switch ON hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is power available in other appliances connected to the same room or power outlet?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya usi kamre ke baki switches aur appliances mein light aa rahi hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Did the MCB trip down again immediately when you switched it ON?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya MCB ko ON karte hi wo dobara turant trip (band) ho gaya?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: What do you see on your AC display panel?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Aapko AC display panel par kya dikhai de raha hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Which category does your displayed code belong to?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Display par dikhne wala code kis category ka hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: CH 05 indicates a communication breakdown between indoor and outdoor units. Have you switched off the AC MCB for 3 minutes and turned it back ON?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: CH 05 indoor aur outdoor unit ke beech communication error dikhata hai. Kya aapne AC ka MCB 3 minute ke liye band karke dobara ON kiya?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Did the CH 05 error disappear and normal cooling resume after the MCB power reset?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya MCB reset karne ke baad CH 05 error hat gaya aur cooling shuru hui?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Which exact refrigerant/pressure code is shown: CH 38 (Gas Leak), CH 32 (Discharge Overheat), or CH 35 (Low Pressure)?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Display par inme se kaunsa code hai: CH 38 (Gas Leak), CH 32 (Discharge Overheat), ya CH 35 (Low Pressure)?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: CH 38 means low refrigerant gas detected. Is the AC blowing room-temperature or warm air instead of cool air?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: CH 38 gas ki kami ka sanket hai. Kya AC thandi hawa ki jagah kamre jaisi normal hawa fenk raha hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: CH 32 indicates high compressor discharge temperature. Is the outdoor unit blocked by walls, debris, or dirty condenser fins?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: CH 32 compressor ke garam hone ka sanket hai. Kya outdoor unit ke paas dhool, parda ya hawa rukne ki rukawat hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: After clearing outdoor unit blockage and allowing it to cool down for 15 minutes, did the error clear?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Outdoor unit ki rukawat hatane aur 15 minute thanda hone ke baad kya error theek hua?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Which fan motor code is shown: CH 10 (Indoor Blower Fan), CH 06 (Outdoor Fan/Thermistor), or CH 67 (Outdoor BLDC Motor)?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kaunsa motor error code dikh raha hai: CH 10 (Indoor Blower), CH 06 (Outdoor Fan/Sensor), ya CH 67 (Outdoor BLDC Motor)?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: CH 10 means the indoor blower fan cannot spin freely. Can you hear the indoor fan spinning or is it completely silent?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: CH 10 ka matlab indoor blower fan ghum nahi pa raha. Kya fan ki chalne ki awaaz aa rahi hai ya bilkul shant hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Which inverter/compressor code is shown on display?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Display par kaunsa inverter/compressor error code dikh raha hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: CH 22 occurs when total AC input current exceeds safety limits. Are other heavy appliances (geyser, oven) causing home voltage drop?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: CH 22 tab aata hai jab AC ka current safety limit se zyada ho jaye. Kya ghar mein low voltage ki samasya hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: CH 23 means DC bus voltage dropped below 140V DC. Do you have a voltage stabilizer installed with the AC?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: CH 23 DC voltage kam hone par aata hai. Kya aapke AC ke sath stabilizer laga hua hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Which temperature sensor code is shown: CH 01, CH 02, CH 12, CH 41, CH 44, CH 45, or CH 46?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Inme se kaunsa sensor code display par hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Which PCB / Overheat code is displayed?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kaunsa PCB ya Overheating error code aa raha hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: HL code indicates High Water Level in the condensate drain pan. Is water overflowing or leaking inside the room?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: HL code drain pan mein paani bharne ka sanket hai. Kya kamre ke andar paani tapak raha hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is the code CL (Child Lock) or FL (Filter Cleaning reminder)?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya display par CL (Child Lock) ya FL (Filter Clean) likha hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Did holding the Timer/Function button for 3 seconds remove the CL code?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya remote par Timer/Function button 3 second dabane se CL code hat gaya?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Did cleaning the air filter and pressing Filter Reset clear the FL code?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Filter saaf karke Filter Reset dabane se kya FL code hat gaya?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: How many times does the power or timer LED blink repeatedly between pauses?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Power ya timer LED light lagatar kitni baar blink (chamakti) karti hai pause lene se pehle?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Display shows Po (Jet Mode), Lo (<10°C), HI (>36°C), or Od (Outdoor Temp). These are normal status indicators. Would you like to return to standard cooling mode?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Po (Jet Mode), Lo, HI ya Od normal status indicators hain, koi kharabi nahi hai. Kya aap standard cooling mode par aana chahte hain?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Let's perform a clean electrical reset: Switch off the AC MCB for 5 minutes, turn it back on, and start via remote. Does the error persist?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Chaliye ek electrical reset karte hain: AC ka MCB 5 minute band karke wapas ON karein. Kya error code abhi bhi aa raha hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Where is the water coming from? Inside the room or outside?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Paani kahan se aa raha hai? Kamre ke andar ya bahar?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is the drain pipe bent, twisted, inclined upwards, or submerged in a bucket of water?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya drain pipe muda hua hai, upar utha hai ya paani ki bucket mein duba hua hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is water dripping heavily like a stream, or only minor droplets forming on the casing?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya paani tezi se dhaar ban kar beh raha hai ya sirf halki boondein tapak rahi hain?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is it very humid or rainy today, and is water draining normally through the outdoor drain outlet?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya aaj mausam bahut nam/barish wala hai aur outdoor pipe se paani nikal raha hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Did straightening the pipe and clearing the outlet stop the leak?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Pipe seedha karne aur paani nikalne par kya leak ruk gayi?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Are you noticing light mist/droplets (sweating) on the louvers or water streaming down?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya AC ke louvers/panel par halki boondein (sweating) hain ya paani beh raha hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is the weather currently very humid, rainy, or is a window/door left open in the room?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya aaj mausam bahut nam (humid) ya barish wala hai, ya kamre ki khidki/darwaza khula hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is the AC running on Low Fan Speed with temperature set very low (18°C-20°C)?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya AC Low fan speed aur bahut kam temperature (18°C-20°C) par chal raha hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Did switching to Monsoon (Dry) Mode or increasing fan speed stop the panel droplets?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Dry Mode lagane ya Fan Speed badhane se kya boondein banna band hui?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is the horizontal air louver angled straight down causing cold air to hit the lower casing?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya AC ka flap bilkul neeche jhuka hua hai jisse thandi hawa body se takra rahi hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is any water droplet or condensation reaching electrical sockets, power cords, or wiring?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya paani ki boondein kisi power switch, taar ya socket tak pahunch rahi hain?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: What type of smell do you notice coming from the AC?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: AC se kis tarah ki badboo aa rahi hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is there any visible smoke, sparks, or is the burning smell intense?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya koi dhuan, chingari ya bahut tezz jalne ki badboo aa rahi hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: When was the air filter and indoor cooling coil last cleaned?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Air filter aur indoor coil aakhri baar kab saaf kiye gaye the?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Did cleaning the filter and running the AC on Fan Mode for 30 minutes eliminate the musty odor?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Filter saaf karke 30 minute Fan Mode chalane se kya badboo khatam hui?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Does the odor smell like stagnant drain water coming from the indoor drain tray?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya drain tray mein jama paani ya keechad jaisi badboo aa rahi hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is this a brand new AC or first time turning on after winter season?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya ye naya AC hai ya lambe samay baad pehli baar chalu kiya hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: What kind of noise is your AC making?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Aapke AC se kis tarah ki ajeeb awaaz aa rahi hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is the rattling coming from the indoor wall unit or the outdoor unit?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Rattling ki awaaz indoor unit se aa rahi hai ya bahar wale outdoor unit se?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is the front grill or air filter firmly snapped in place?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya indoor front grill aur filter theek se band hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Does the loud humming occur continuously when compressor starts or only at turn on?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya tezz humming awaaz compressor start hote hi aati hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is the gurgling/hissing heard during defrosting / right after turning off?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya gurgling/hissing ki awaaz AC band hone ya mode badalne par aati hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is the LCD display on your remote control showing any text or icons?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya remote ke screen (display) par koi text ya icon dikh raha hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Did inserting a brand new pair of AAA alkaline batteries restore the remote display?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Nayi AAA batteries daalne ke baad kya remote display chalu hua?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Point the remote tip at your smartphone camera and press buttons. Do you see a flashing purplish/red light on the camera screen?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Remote ko phone ke camera ke aage rakh kar button dabayein. Kya phone screen par pink/purple light chamakti dikhi?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Does the AC beep or respond to any button on the indoor unit's manual emergency switch?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya AC par manual power switch dabane se beep ki awaaz aati hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is any air coming out of the AC vents at all?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya AC ke vents se bilkul bhi hawa nikal rahi hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Can you hear the indoor fan motor humming or does it show error CH 10?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya indoor fan motor ki humming sunai de rahi hai ya display par CH 10 aa raha hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is the air filter heavily clogged with dust, or is there visible ice on the indoor coil fins?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya filter dhool se jam gaya hai ya cooling fins par barf (ice) dikh rahi hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Did cleaning the filter restore strong, normal airflow?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Filter saaf karne se kya hawa ka pressure wapas normal ho gaya?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is the fan speed set to High (F3/F5) or is the indoor blower wheel visibly caked with deep dirt?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya fan speed High par hai aur kya blower wheel ke blades par moti dhool ki parat jami hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Are you performing routine 15-day cleaning or troubleshooting poor cooling / bad odor?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya aap 15-din ki routine safai kar rahe hain ya kam cooling/badboo ki vajah se saaf kar rahe hain?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Have you removed the filter using the designated tabs and washed it with normal water and a soft brush?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya aapne filter ko tabs se bahar nikal kar normal paani aur soft brush se dho liya hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is the air filter 100% dry in shade? (Never install a wet filter as it causes mold and short circuit risk).
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya filter chhaon mein poori tarah sookh chuka hai? (Geela filter kabhi na lagayein).

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Which operating function or setting is not behaving as expected?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kaunsa feature ya setting theek se kaam nahi kar raha?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: When you press the 'Mode' button on remote, does the mode icon change on both remote and AC panel?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Remote par 'Mode' dabane par kya icon remote aur AC panel dono par badalta hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Inverter ACs have a 3-minute compressor protection safety delay before starting cooling. Has 3 minutes passed?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Inverter AC mein cooling shuru hone mein 3 minute ka safety delay hota hai. Kya 3 minute ho chuke hain?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is the AC turning off automatically due to an active Timer or Sleep Mode?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya AC kisi purane Timer ya Sleep mode ki vajah se khud band ho raha hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is the swing flap stuck in one position or making a clicking sound?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya swing flap ek jagah atka hua hai ya tik-tik ki awaaz kar raha hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is 'Energy Saver' or '6-in-1 AI Convertible' mode limiting cooling capacity to 40% / 60%?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya Convertible mode ne capacity ko 40% ya 60% par limit kar rakha hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Was this AC newly installed within the last 7 to 30 days?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya ye AC pichhle 7 se 30 dino ke andar naya install hua hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: What specific installation issue are you observing?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Installation mein kaunsi specific dikkat dikh rahi hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Which physical part of the AC is cracked, broken, or damaged?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: AC ka kaunsa hissa toota ya damage hua hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is there any exposed high-voltage wiring, internal PCB, or live parts visible through the damage?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya toote hisse se koi nanga bijli ka taar ya internal PCB bahar dikh raha hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Are the outdoor condenser blue fins bent over a large area, blocking air flow?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya outdoor unit ke blue fins mude hue hain jisse hawa ruk rahi hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Which spare part or accessory do you need for your LG AC?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Aapko LG AC ke liye kaunsa spare part ya accessory chahiye?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Do you have the exact model number (e.g., UW-Q18WUZA, MS-Q18YNZA) from the side sticker?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya aapke paas AC ka exact model number likha hua hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is the AC within the 1-Year Comprehensive Warranty period or covered under AMC?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya AC 1 saal ki warranty ya AMC ke andar hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: What issue are you facing with LG ThinQ smart features?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: LG ThinQ app ya smart features ke sath kya dikkat aa rahi hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is your Wi-Fi router broadcasting on 2.4 GHz band? (LG ACs only connect to 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, not 5 GHz).
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya aapka Wi-Fi router 2.4 GHz band par hai? (LG AC sirf 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi se connect hota hai).

diagnosticNodes.text_en: After pressing the Wi-Fi button on remote for 3 seconds until the Wi-Fi icon blinks, did pairing succeed?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Remote par Wi-Fi button 3 second dabane ke baad kya app mein AC pair ho gaya?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Did you recently change your home Wi-Fi password, router, or internet provider?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya aapne haal hi mein Wi-Fi password, router ya internet connection badla hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Did turning off the AC MCB for 2 minutes and restarting the ThinQ app bring the AC back online?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: AC ka MCB 2 minute band karke on karne aur app restart karne par kya AC online aaya?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Have you already attempted self-troubleshooting steps without success?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya aap pehle hi troubleshooting steps try kar chuke hain par dikkat bani hui hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Is there any smoke, burning smell, exposed wiring, water near electrical sockets, or repeated breaker tripping?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Kya koi dhuan, jalne ki smell, nanga taar, socket ke paas paani ya baar-baar MCB trip hone ki dikkat hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: Which primary category best describes your issue?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Aapki dikkat kis category mein aati hai?

diagnosticNodes.text_en: How would you like to proceed with LG Service Support?
diagnosticNodes.text_hi: Aap LG Service Support se kis tarah sampark karna chahte hain?

conclusions.probable_cause: Low Refrigerant Gas (R32) due to Micro-leakage
conclusions.technician_note: Conduct 300 PSI nitrogen leak test on indoor/outdoor flare joints. Braze leak, vacuum down to 500 microns, refill R32 by weight.
conclusions.rag_query: LG AC poor cooling ice on coil refrigerant recharge

conclusions.probable_cause: Outdoor Fan Motor or Starting Capacitor Failure / Low Grid Voltage
conclusions.technician_note: Discharge capacitor safely before testing capacitance. Measure voltage under compressor start load.
conclusions.rag_query: LG AC outdoor fan motor humming capacitor replacement

conclusions.probable_cause: Inverter Compressor Drive / Outdoor Main PCB Failure
conclusions.technician_note: High voltage risk. Check DC Link voltage and IPM output to compressor U, V, W terminals.
conclusions.rag_query: LG AC outdoor unit not starting inverter board troubleshooting

conclusions.probable_cause: Clogged Heat Exchanger Coils or Thermal Sensor Drift
conclusions.technician_note: Check indoor thermistor calibration at 25°C. Perform foam jet cleaning of condenser.
conclusions.rag_query: LG AC poor cooling room temperature sensor check

conclusions.probable_cause: Dead Short Circuit in Inverter Compressor / Outdoor PCB / Power Cord
conclusions.technician_note: DANGER: DO NOT ATTEMPT TO FORCE MCB ON. Disconnect power cord and megger test compressor windings to ground.
conclusions.rag_query: LG AC MCB trips immediately short circuit safety troubleshooting

conclusions.probable_cause: Indoor PCB Power Fuse Blown (3.15A/250V) or Varistor Surge Damage
conclusions.technician_note: Check input AC 230V at CN-POWER terminal. Test continuity of PCB fuse and primary SMPS transformer.
conclusions.rag_query: LG AC indoor PCB blown fuse surge repair

conclusions.probable_cause: PCB SMPS Power Supply Fault or Microcontroller Lockup
conclusions.technician_note: Inspect 12V and 5V DC regulated rails on indoor PCB.
conclusions.rag_query: LG AC power shuts down immediately after start

conclusions.probable_cause: Loose AC Wall Plug / Burnt Isolator Switch Contacts
conclusions.technician_note: Verify 230V line-to-neutral and <2V neutral-to-earth at wall socket.
conclusions.rag_query: LG AC power plug loose neutral wire test

conclusions.probable_cause: Communication Cable Fault or Outdoor PCB Communication Circuit Failure (CH 05 / CH 53)
conclusions.technician_note: Measure DC pulse voltage between Terminal 1/2 and Neutral. Check for loose terminal block screws or rodent-damaged wires.
conclusions.rag_query: CH 05 communication troubleshooting steps and PCB voltage check

conclusions.probable_cause: Refrigerant Gas Leakage / Insufficient R32 Charge (CH 38)
conclusions.technician_note: Pressurize system with Nitrogen to 350 PSI. Soap test flare joints and U-bends. Braze leaks, evacuate to 500 microns, weigh gas in grams per nameplate.
conclusions.rag_query: CH 38 refrigerant gas leak detection and vacuum recharge procedure

conclusions.probable_cause: Compressor Discharge Pipe Overheating (>105°C) or Clogged Condenser (CH 32)
conclusions.technician_note: Inspect discharge pipe temperature sensor and refrigerant subcooling. Pressure wash outdoor coil.
conclusions.rag_query: CH 32 high discharge temperature troubleshooting

conclusions.probable_cause: Low Pressure Drop or Electronic Expansion Valve (EEV) Blockage (CH 35)
conclusions.technician_note: Verify EEV coil pulse signals and suction operating pressure.
conclusions.rag_query: CH 35 low pressure sensor fault fix

conclusions.probable_cause: Outdoor Pipe Sensor Open/Short or Outdoor Fan Motor Stalled (CH 06)
conclusions.technician_note: Measure outdoor pipe sensor resistance. Test outdoor fan motor winding continuity.
conclusions.rag_query: CH 06 outdoor sensor and fan motor diagnostic

conclusions.probable_cause: Indoor BLDC Blower Motor Locked or Casing Obstruction (CH 10)
conclusions.technician_note: Inspect for physical obstruction. Check motor shaft bearing play and Hall sensor feedback pulses on CN-MOTOR connector.
conclusions.rag_query: CH 10 indoor blower fan motor lock troubleshooting

conclusions.probable_cause: Indoor Fan Motor Hall Sensor IC Failure (CH 10)
conclusions.technician_note: Check 5V DC supply and feedback pulse on PCB connector while rotating blower wheel by hand.
conclusions.rag_query: CH 10 Hall sensor feedback circuit check

conclusions.probable_cause: Outdoor BLDC Fan Motor Overcurrent / Rotor Lock (CH 67)
conclusions.technician_note: Check outdoor fan blade freedom. Measure U-V-W motor winding resistances (balanced approx 40-70Ω).
conclusions.rag_query: CH 67 outdoor BLDC motor lock repair

conclusions.probable_cause: Inverter IPM DC Peak / Compressor Overcurrent (CH 21)
conclusions.technician_note: High voltage risk. Check IPM diode resistance. Megger test compressor winding insulation to ground.
conclusions.rag_query: CH 21 IPM overcurrent inverter diagnostic

conclusions.probable_cause: Input AC Overcurrent Due to Low Grid Voltage (CH 22)
conclusions.technician_note: Measure running AC current with clamp meter. If grid voltage dips below 190V under compressor load, install stabilizer.
conclusions.rag_query: CH 22 AC input current limit low voltage fix

errorCodes.customer_action: Reset AC by turning off MCB for 3 minutes. If error returns, book service.
errorCodes.technician_action: Check resistance of indoor air sensor (5kΩ-10kΩ at 25°C). Check PCB connector CN-TH1.

errorCodes.customer_action: Reset AC. Do not attempt to open unit.
errorCodes.technician_action: Measure pipe inlet sensor resistance. Verify sensor is properly clipped to copper pipe.

errorCodes.customer_action: Check if outdoor unit has power. Reset MCB once.
errorCodes.technician_action: Check continuity of communication wire (F1/F2 or L1/L2). Check terminal block tightness. Test PCB signal output.

errorCodes.description: Drain Pump Error or Float Switch Open
errorCodes.customer_action: Check if drain hose is kinked or submerged in water bucket.
errorCodes.technician_action: Test drain pump operation. Check float switch continuity. Clear drain line obstruction.

errorCodes.description: Communication Error Between Indoor and Outdoor Unit
errorCodes.customer_action: Ensure outdoor unit is powered. Reset system via MCB for 5 minutes.
errorCodes.technician_action: Check DC voltage between L1-L2 (should fluctuate 0-24V). Inspect wiring for cuts. Replace Indoor PCB first, then Outdoor PCB.

errorCodes.customer_action: Turn off AC immediately. Do not restart until serviced.
errorCodes.technician_action: Check fan blade for obstruction. Measure motor winding resistance. Test capacitor. Check PCB fan driver circuit.

errorCodes.customer_action: Ensure all indoor units are set to same mode (all Cool or all Heat). Mixed modes cause this error.
errorCodes.technician_action: Verify DIP switch settings on outdoor PCB match installation type. Reset system.

errorCodes.customer_action: Turn off AC. Book technician visit.
errorCodes.technician_action: Check blower wheel for debris. Measure BLDC motor feedback signal. Test indoor PCB fan driver.

errorCodes.description: Indoor Unit Drain Level High (Water Overflow Risk)
errorCodes.customer_action: Turn off AC immediately to prevent water damage. Check drain hose for blockage.
errorCodes.technician_action: Clear drain pipe clog. Test drain pump. Check float sensor position. Verify proper drain slope.

errorCodes.customer_action: Reset AC via MCB. If persists, schedule service.
errorCodes.technician_action: Check outlet pipe sensor connection and resistance. Ensure sensor is seated correctly on U-bend.

errorCodes.description: Outdoor IPM Fault (Inverter Power Module Overcurrent)
errorCodes.customer_action: Turn off AC at MCB. Do NOT attempt to restart. Call authorized service.
errorCodes.technician_action: Check compressor winding resistance. Test IPM module on outdoor PCB. Check refrigerant charge. Verify no mechanical lock in compressor.

errorCodes.customer_action: Reset system. If error returns, stop using unit.
errorCodes.technician_action: Check CT sensor connection on outdoor PCB. Measure current draw vs rated amps. Replace CT or PCB if faulty.

errorCodes.customer_action: Check home voltage stability. Use stabilizer if voltage <190V.
errorCodes.technician_action: Measure input AC voltage. Check rectifier bridge and smoothing capacitors on outdoor PCB. Verify compressor not drawing excessive current.

errorCodes.description: High Pressure Switch Open / Discharge Temp Too High
errorCodes.customer_action: Turn off AC. Ensure outdoor unit is not blocked. Clean condenser coil if accessible.
errorCodes.technician_action: Check condenser cleanliness. Verify fan operation. Measure discharge pressure. Check high-pressure switch continuity. Verify refrigerant charge.

errorCodes.customer_action: Turn off AC immediately. Do not retry. Book urgent service.
errorCodes.technician_action: Check compressor terminals U-V-W resistance. Test start/run capacitor. Check for mechanical seizure. Verify PCB output to compressor.

errorCodes.customer_action: Reset via MCB. If persistent, stop use.
errorCodes.technician_action: Check PFC reactor connections. Test PFC diode and MOSFET on outdoor PCB. Verify input voltage waveform.

errorCodes.customer_action: Turn off AC. Recent electrical work may have swapped phases.
errorCodes.technician_action: For 3-phase models: Swap any two input phase wires. For single-phase: Check compressor wiring sequence and capacitor.

errorCodes.customer_action: Clean outdoor unit condenser coil. Ensure adequate airflow clearance.
errorCodes.technician_action: Check condenser cleanliness. Verify refrigerant charge (low gas causes high discharge temp). Test discharge sensor accuracy.

errorCodes.customer_action: Reset system. Schedule service if error continues.
errorCodes.technician_action: Check outdoor pipe sensor connection and resistance. Verify sensor placement on condenser coil.

errorCodes.customer_action: Reset AC. Service needed if persistent.
errorCodes.technician_action: Test ambient sensor resistance. Check PCB connector. Replace sensor if out of spec.

errorCodes.customer_action: Reset system via MCB.
errorCodes.technician_action: Check discharge sensor clip on compressor top. Measure resistance. Replace if open/short.

errorCodes.customer_action: Reset AC. Book service if unresolved.
errorCodes.technician_action: Locate mid-condenser sensor. Test resistance and connection integrity.

errorCodes.customer_action: Reset system.
errorCodes.technician_action: Check suction pipe sensor attachment. Measure resistance. Verify no moisture ingress in connector.

errorCodes.customer_action: Power cycle system. Professional repair required.
errorCodes.technician_action: Re-flash outdoor PCB firmware if supported. Otherwise replace outdoor main PCB.

errorCodes.customer_action: Turn off AC for 30 minutes. Check for blocked outdoor unit airflow.
errorCodes.technician_action: Check condenser blockage. Measure running amps. Verify refrigerant charge. Check ambient temperature conditions.

errorCodes.customer_action: Ensure outdoor unit has proper ventilation. Turn off for 20 mins.
errorCodes.technician_action: Check heatsink thermal paste application. Verify fan speed. Clean heatsink fins. Check IPM mounting torque.

errorCodes.customer_action: Stop using AC. Authorized service only.
errorCodes.technician_action: Check compressor terminal connections. Test IPM output. Verify compressor not mechanically locked. May require compressor replacement.

errorCodes.customer_action: This appears during initial setup. Contact installer.
errorCodes.technician_action: Complete auto-addressing procedure. Verify DIP switches. Run commissioning test mode per service manual.
